summary: Greystone Housing Impact Investors LP filed an 8-K on September 16, 2026, announcing that the Board of Managers of its general partner's general partner declared a regular quarterly cash distribution of $0.14 per Beneficial Unit Certificate (BUC). The distribution is payable October 30, 2026 to holders of record at the close of trading September 30, 2026, with BUCs trading ex-distribution as of September 30. A related press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine quarterly distribution declaration for a mortgage revenue bond-focused limited partnership, not a special situation; no premium, deal price, advisor, or structural overhang is implicated. Watch only distribution coverage and net asset value trends.
